conditions.runtime: Cosmetic Armor Reworked 1.20.1-v1a is installed with matching versions on the Forge client and server

change.summary: Add the native Cosmetic Armor Reworked client-and-server extension so players can separate displayed armor from functional armor.

modifiers.after: The native mod owns four cosmetic armor slots, armor visibility toggles, synchronization and rendering. Functional armor stats and ordinary armor inventory ownership remain unchanged.

modifiers.before: The active JEM Release pack excludes Cosmetic Armor resources, leaving the mod's bright native inventory atlas visible beside the styled player inventory.
modifiers.after: JEM Release deterministically reuses its own inventory bank, crafting material and recessed slot pixels inside Cosmetic Armor's exact native screen geometry while preserving the mod's controls and runtime behavior.

rationale.purpose: Let players choose armor appearance independently from protection without adding a second JEM armor-state owner.
rationale.decision_source: The user explicitly requested Cosmetic Armor on 2026-10-28, then on 2026-11-06 requested that its vanilla-looking GUI reuse the existing JEM Release assets. The implementation keeps the native mod as behavior owner and adds only a resource-pack presentation adapter.

introduced.summary: Install Cosmetic Armor Reworked 1.20.1-v1a on both client and server.

history.summary: Add the exact CurseForge file 4600191 with SHA-1 afd9fa3fe95e8c086e8d439df403ed1e5ea5cbea and retain its native client/server ownership.
Reuse the released JEM inventory materials inside Cosmetic Armor's exact native atlas geometry without changing menu or synchronization ownership.

relations: The exact mod metadata declares Forge 47+ and MATCH_VERSION on both sides
The mod adds presentation slots and does not replace native functional armor stats
JEM Release owns only the pixel presentation and preserves the mod's native 256x256 atlas, 176x166 screen region and runtime-drawn controls
Redistributed binary source is available at https://github.com/zlainsama/CosmeticArmorReworked under the embedded MMPL 1.0.1 license
notes: The installed archive has no additional mod dependency beyond Forge.
unresolved: Client inventory-screen and multiplayer synchronization acceptance remain unobserved because the client was not launched.
